name: Rasa Industries, Ltd.
summary: Rasa Industries, Ltd. is involved in the chemicals, machinery, and electronic materials businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells phosphoric acid and phosphorus-based secondary salts, coagulants for water treatment, high-performance, high-purity chemicals for the electronics industry, and deodorizing and antibacterial products. It also offers high-purity chemical agents, tunneling machines, crushing related machines, municipal and industrial waste treatment machines, steel castings, high-purity inorganic materials, radioactive iodine adsorbents, and coatings.
